activities.anchor: The pressure that produced modernism was a crisis
activities.caption: pair each pressure with the form it forced
activities.name: modPressureMatch

config.prompt: The world broke; form followed — pair the pressure with the answer:

pairs.left: a mind mostly below the surface (Freud)
pairs.right: stream of consciousness — thought as it actually moves, associative, ungrammatical, looping
'moments of being' flowing against clock sequence — Mrs Dalloway, To the Lighthouse

pairs.left: industrial war and the city dissolving legible order
pairs.right: the confident omniscient narrator begins to look like a comfortable fiction
one Dublin day, 18 episodes, a thousand shifting styles — banned in the US until the famous 1933 ruling

config.why: The modernist answer was to rebuild literature from the inside of consciousness out.

activities.anchor: The second modernist discovery is that
activities.caption: find the line the collage history contradicts
activities.name: modFragmentSpot

config.prompt: One line of this techniques report is wrong — click it:
lines: The Waste Land is a collage — five languages, quotations, abrupt cuts.
Pound's Imagist doctrine: direct treatment of the thing; no word that does not earn its place.
Conrad's Marlow and Kafka's nightmares extend the unreliable narration.
Montage was invented by the modernist poets and only later borrowed by film.
Modernism's wager: difficulty is honesty — an easy form would be lying about the world.
config.correction: The borrowing ran the other way — montage came from film into literature.
config.why: Fragmentation can be organised by something older than realism: a parallel to the Grail legend (and to Joyce's Odyssey) gives the modern chaos a shape the modern world no longer supplies.

activities.anchor: Postmodernism's philosophical core is Jean-François Lyotard's definition
activities.caption: pair each technique with its instance
activities.name: modPlayMatch

config.prompt: Play after the crisis — pair the technique with the text that shows it:

pairs.right: Calvino's Reader whose book keeps restarting — every reading is both story and subject
Borges's infinite libraries and forking paths — narrative's claim to single truth dissolves
imitating styles without the parody's satirical bite
García Márquez — the marvellous narrated as domestic fact
Morrison's Beloved — the ghost story carries slavery's suppressed archive

config.why: Where modernism fragmented in anguish, postmodernism fragments in play — and the best postmodernism is rarely 'just play'.

activities.caption: one street, three styles — put them in era order
activities.name: modStylesOrder

config.prompt: A man hurries through a city street to keep an appointment — order the tellings, earliest movement first:
items: Victorian realism — transparent: 'Mr Bloom walked quickly toward the bridge'
Modernism — the perceiving mind: sensory drift, interruption, the past erupting mid-sentence
Postmodernism — the narration itself interrupts: the sentence notes it is a sentence; another version begins
config.why: Three styles, three epistemologies — one event.

activities.anchor: Brian McHale's formulation gives the distinction its cleanest edge
activities.caption: file each question under the movement it belongs to
activities.name: modMcHaleBuckets

config.prompt: The one-line test, expanded — file each question:

items.label: 'How can I know this world? Who is perceiving? What is certain?'
'Which world is this? How many worlds?'
'What is real in a text that keeps collapsing levels?'
suspects the depth was always another surface

config.why: Modernism's dominant question is epistemological; postmodernism's is ontological — precise enough to sort a page sentence by sentence.

activities.anchor: opens with the most shocking simile
activities.caption: true or false — Prufrock and Penelope
activities.name: modCloseupJudge

statements.s: The evening is spread out 'like a patient etherised upon a table' — perception itself numbed.
statements.why: The simile performs the modern condition in eleven words: romance's consolations refused.

statements.s: The rhetorically grand question 'Do I dare?' gets answered by the poem's end.
statements.why: It never gets answered — the hero rehearses action and grows old rehearsing; the mermaids, famously, will not sing to him.

statements.s: Molly Bloom's monologue runs roughly 24,000 words in eight enormous sentences with no full stops.
statements.why: The punctuation of sleep, association and desire — running from 'yes' to 'yes I will Yes.'

statements.s: The close-up poem is an anti-epiphany whose form enacts paralysis.
statements.why: Difficulty here is structure, not decoration.

config.root: A narrator's account and the story the text lets you reconstruct have diverged. Locate the gap.

choices.label: Between the narrating I and the experiencing I
choices.feedback: The one who tells diverges from the one who lived it — Huck's innocence, Stevens's dignity-obsessed self-interest.

choices.label: Between narrator and implied author — the text admits its own unreliability
choices.feedback: The postmodern radicalisation: the whole archive is suspect.

voices.text: Ford's The Good Soldier makes the reader the detective of a single catastrophic misunderstanding — the pleasure is forensic: catching the tell-tale evasions, supplying what the teller conceals.

choices.label: Now the postmodern end of the scale

radical.text: Rushdie's Midnight's Children narrates a national history its narrator admits is riddled with errors — then asks which error is truer than fact.

config.why: Reading against the telling is the professional skill this device teaches — and media literacy's core move.

activities.anchor: The heavyweight critiques give you the debate's two poles
activities.caption: file each critique by the flank it attacks from
activities.name: modCritiqueBuckets

items.label: Jameson: pastiche and depthlessness as the cultural form of consumer capitalism — history flattening into images
Baudrillard's simulacra: copies without originals, the hyperreal
Habermas: modernity's project is incomplete, not bankrupt
Wallace's 'E Unibus Pluram': a generation raised on irony was lonely inside it — the new sincerity

config.why: The symptom reading, the hyperreal radicalised, and the two defences — a thesis postmodernism is accused of performing rather than analysing, answered by sincerity inside formal sophistication.
